title: Language recognized by padded circuits
statement: Let $\ell:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $\ell(n)\le n$ for every $n$, and let $F_n$ be a Boolean function on $\ell(n)$ inputs for each $n$. The language of Boolean words $w$ for which the padded circuit at length $|w|$ evaluates to true on $w$ is the language recognized by this family.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a function from natural numbers to natural numbers
For each $n$, $F_n$ is a Boolean function on $\ell(n)$ inputs
caveat: The exact construction of the padded circuit depends on `universalCircuit` and `widenCircuit`, whose definitions are not supplied.
